methodology: Precomputed synthetic or BMOPF geometry; identity and placement recorded per dataset. No viewport culling or network level of detail; optional open-switch presentation is prepared once on load. Frame intervals from deck.gl onAfterRender; not GPU timer queries. First-draw callback is not a GPU completion fence.

comparisonNotes: Results resident in overlays-off baseline. Compare only completed 692×500 CSS-pixel runs at DPR 2; first SAPN off run at 492×440 is excluded from the comparison because viewport changed between runs.
SAPN values are artificial rendering stress, not a solution. French values are saved Tellegen multiconductor results.
One completed sample per compared mode; frame delivery timings, not GPU timings or statistically significant speed differences.
After recording, warning label pixel offset moved from -14 to -32 to avoid selected-ID overlap; no data, query, animation, layer count or camera changes.
